mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_tokens (user_id, token_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, expires_at, revoked_at, rotated_at FROM refresh_tokens WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked_at = #{at}, rotated_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
